verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents API tokens and API-token auth for its JMAP API, and a community user confirms app passwords can be restricted to a single protocol (SMTP only). That shows Fastmail offers credential scoping, but the pack never documents per-token scopes or permissions for API tokens. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of scope selection for API tokens (e.g. read-only or mail-only permissions), evidence of per-agent token management and revocation, and independent corroboration of least-privilege API access.
